headline: Where Have You Been All These Days? No Arbitrariness Will Be Allowed... HC Gives ED a Earful in Cafe Coffee Day Case
summary: A High Court is hearing a petition challenging a show-cause notice issued by the FEMA Adjudicating Authority and a later hearing notice in the Cafe Coffee Day case. The court criticised the agency's conduct.
why: Cafe Coffee Day is an Indian coffee chain run by Coffee Day Enterprises. Foreign exchange enforcement cases affect corporate compliance and regulatory risk.
